# Halcyon Stereo

Fictional vintage hi-fi and records shop in Portland, Oregon (est. 1974). Design and
development portfolio piece by Stephen Fehon; all businesses, people, products, prices,
events, and contact details are invented. No frameworks, static HTML/CSS/JS.

## Pages
- index.html: home, featured gear, crate picks, service summary
- about.html: shop story, five-decade timeline, staff
- inventory.html: filterable catalog of restored gear
- turntable-tt500.html, receiver-r70.html, speakers-ls6.html: gear detail pages
- records.html: crate system and grading policy
- service.html: published bench rates and repair process
- events.html: listening nights and clinics calendar
- journal.html, journal-sansui.html, journal-care.html: journal and two entries
- trade-in.html: selling/trading policy and form
- contact.html: hours, address, visit guide
- faq.html: fourteen questions
- privacy.html, terms.html: demo policies
- 404.html: not-found page

## Design identity
Warm retro-futurist 1970s: bone cream, burnt orange, mustard, walnut, avocado accent.
Fonts: Anybody (variable, width axis) and Figtree, self-hosted WOFF2. Film grain, sunburst
and wood-grain motifs, ticket-stub cards, spinning-vinyl canvas hero, VU-meter canvas,
lamp-switch theme toggle, scroll-driven animations with graceful fallback, reduced-motion
honored. WCAG 2.2 AA target.
